cross_field_check: Checked 8 sessions / 45 minutes / 412 applicants / 37 qualified / 30 days (tab 1, mockup, image; image row '3 weeks ago' is inside 30 days); 60 completes per size group, 50-499 and 500+, day 2, close page (tab 2, feature_3, step 6, mockup, image); 8 activities, 290 applicants, 23 set aside, 41 qualified, 3 or more runs (tab 3, step 1, FAQ 1, mockup, image); 800 started, 184 qualified = 23%, 122/200 = 61%, 62/600 = 10% (tab 4, image, alt); FAQ 9 150 / 0.25 = 600. Alert channel: Slack research channel or email to study lead (feature_5) - no conflicting channel elsewhere. All third-party statements (SurveyMonkey x4, CloudResearch x2, NN/g x2) match domain_sources quotes. No mismatch found.

notes.rule: HUB_RULES 2a (page does not contradict its own advice)
notes.finding: Tab 1's screener 'asks when each applicant last cooked from a meal kit, and only answers within the past 30 days qualify', which names the qualifying behavior outright, while step 4 ('Hide the qualifying answer') and FAQ 6 ('ask which kitchen appliances people own before you ask anything about coffee') tell the reader not to tip off the criterion.
notes.fix: Tab 1: ask which ways people cooked dinner last month, with meal kits among the options, then ask when they last cooked one.

notes.finding: 'Put every screener up front' uses 'screener' for a single question; everywhere else 'screener' is the whole survey ('Host the screener on your own domain').
'No. Open with the first screening question, since a warm-up only delays the answer' is an unsourced recommendation.

PAA and related searches ask for good screening questions and examples; the page shows them only inside tabs and steps (meal kit recency, role/company size/sign-off, activity list), with no consolidated example set.
notes.fix: On the next edit, let FAQ 1 or step 1 list 3-4 sample screening questions.

notes.finding: ', so' ending (QC Q5 P2): 'Emergent builds the questions and the rules that sort each answer, so the people who reach your study are the ones it needs.'
